original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target literally with target-selection.json/full_target and mathematically with problem.md:16-41: arbitrary prime p, arbitrary characteristic-p field K, integer 0<=lambda<p, the specified complex module and highest vector, and an arbitrary admissible lattice are all retained. H001-H004 retain all original givens and their locations; no original H node is unused. Within H002, the irreducible/highest-weight classification is retained even though the calculation only needs its dimension, the displayed commutators, and H003. There is no minimal-lattice or algebraic-closure assumption. D001-D006 preserve n, the divided-power vectors and enveloping-algebra divided powers; D006 carefully distinguishes abstract Chevalley generators from their represented operators. D007-D011 preserve localization, arbitrary-lattice coordinates and the common coefficient module: M_R is initially the R-span image, and R002 proves the required tensor embedding, rather than assuming it. D009 has the proved N001 basis guard, present directly at every relevant inference. R-related definitions have H001 as guard. D012 is precisely the original tensor product. D013/D015 give the original abstract integral Chevalley algebra, not its potentially nonfaithful image on V; the displayed integer matrix model and R006/S004 establish the bracket/action identification, including lambda=0 and characteristic 2. D014 only extends genuinely lattice-preserving operators; R002 supplies preservation before reduction is used. D016 is the usual prime field under H001. The six selected native sources M001-M006 were actually probed in the pinned checkout and their complete signatures compared with their statements: algebra/module structures in M001/M003, finite/free factors and strong rank condition in M002, the finite basis and strong rank condition in M004, and all numerical premises in M005/M006 are present. The corresponding native source contexts were read, including the three IsLocalizedModule clauses. Humphreys is provenance of the frozen exercise, not an imported proof theorem; there is no selected literature E or inaccessible-primary assumption. The graph has one producer for each N/P, only H/M roots, and all six M and five N lie in P's AND closure. The six inference units preserve all five supplied phases, splitting the common-coordinate module and its rank/generator argument into R003 and R004. No supplied core calculation or intermediate argument was omitted. This is my same-author mathematical inspection, not independent Audit A; structural validity alone is not being called mathematical acceptance.
